Verify pinout, thermal margin, and official manufacturer datasheets before production.

selection_checklist: Verify exact pin numbering on SOT-23-3 (1=VOUT, 2=VIN, 3=GND) and exposed pad net (None).
Confirm output capacitor ESR stability (MLCC stable) and DC-bias derated capacitance >= 0.1 µF.
Check worst-case junction temperature Tj = Ta + (Vin,max - 3.3 V) × Iout × θJA stays >= 15 °C below Tj,max (150 °C).
Validate input transient headroom against Vin,max (30 V rec / 35 V abs) and Pin 4 (NC vs BYPASS) PCB net connectivity.
